name: Ioun Stone Northern Star
body:
Northern Star (Normal) Ioun Stone
Source Heroes from the Fringe pg. 15
Aura strong transmutation; CL 12th
Slot none; Price 10,000 gp; Weight —
Description
This pearlescent crystal is perfectly cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. It grants the bearer a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics and Climb checks. When inserted into a wayfinder, it grants the bearer a +4 bonus on Reflex saves to avoid falling.
Resonance
+4 bonus on Reflex Saves to avoid falling
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, jump, creator must be at least 12th level; Cost 5,000 gp
